story_title: As an Event Organiser, I want to save an incomplete event request as a draft so that I can complete or review it before submitting it.

acceptance_criteria.text: Given I have entered some event information, when I select "Save Draft", then the request is saved.
A saved draft is clearly identified as a draft.
I can leave the system and return to the draft later.
I can edit the information in the draft.
A draft is not treated as a submitted event request.

test_cases.title: Save Draft creates a saved draft with only a title
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as Rachel Ng (rachel.ng@meridianfina.com / password123), a seeded Organiser. On the "New event request" page.
steps: Enter "Annual Partner Appreciation Dinner" into Event name
test_cases.test_data: Event name: Annual Partner Appreciation Dinner
test_cases.expected_result:
The browser returns to the "My events" page.
The event appears under "Drafts — not yet submitted" with the title "Annual Partner Appreciation Dinner" and a "Draft" status badge.

test_cases.title: Save Draft is blocked when the event name is empty
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as rachel.ng@meridianfina.com / password123, on the "New event request" page, all fields blank.
test_cases.expected_result: The page does not move on. A message "Give the event a name so you can find it again." appears under Event name, and the cursor moves there.

test_cases.title: Save Draft treats a whitespace-only title the same as empty
test_cases.preconditions: Logged in as rachel.ng@meridianfina.com / password123, on the "New event request" page.
test_cases.expected_result: The page does not move on. The same message, "Give the event a name so you can find it again.", appears under Event name — typing only spaces counts as leaving it blank.

test_cases.title: A saved draft is shown under its own 'Drafts' section with a Draft badge
test_cases.preconditions: Seeded account rachel.ng@meridianfina.com owns the seeded draft "Q1 Investor Update (rough idea)" and the seeded, already-completed event "Meridian Compliance Training".
test_cases.expected_result: The page shows a "Drafts — not yet submitted (1)" section listing "Q1 Investor Update (rough idea)" with a grey "Draft" badge, sitting above and separate from the "Submitted" section, which lists "Meridian Compliance Training".

test_cases.title: Opening a draft also shows the Draft badge on its own page
test_cases.preconditions: Seeded draft "Q1 Investor Update (rough idea)" owned by rachel.ng@meridianfina.com.
steps: Click the "Q1 Investor Update (rough idea)" row
test_cases.expected_result: The "Edit draft" page opens, showing the subtitle "Pick up where you left off. Nothing here is sent until you submit it." together with a "Draft" badge next to the title.

test_cases.title: Organiser can leave and return to a saved draft
test_cases.preconditions: Seeded draft "Q1 Investor Update (rough idea)" owned by rachel.ng@meridianfina.com. Its saved description reads "Still checking dates with the exec team."
steps: Log back in as rachel.ng@meridianfina.com / password123
Click the "Q1 Investor Update (rough idea)" row
test_cases.expected_result:
The "Edit draft" page opens with every previously saved value already filled in, including the Description field reading "Still checking dates with the exec team."
The Draft badge is still shown.

test_cases.title: A draft is not visible to an unrelated organiser
test_cases.preconditions: Seeded draft "Q1 Investor Update (rough idea)" is owned by rachel.ng@meridianfina.com (Meridian Financial Group). budi.santoso@nusantaratec.com is an Organiser at an unrelated organisation, Nusantara Tech Labs. Rachel's draft's edit-page web address has been copied (e.g. from the address bar while logged in as her).
steps: Paste Rachel's draft's edit-page address into the browser and go to it
test_cases.expected_result: The page shows "This draft could not be found. It may have been removed, or it isn't yours." instead of the form — Budi never sees any of Rachel's draft content.

test_cases.title: Visiting a draft's edit link while logged out redirects to login
test_cases.preconditions: Seeded draft "Q1 Investor Update (rough idea)" exists. No one is logged in.
steps: Make sure you are logged out
Paste the draft's edit-page address into the browser and go to it
test_cases.expected_result: The browser is redirected to the login page instead of showing the draft. After logging in, it takes you straight back to the draft's edit page.

test_cases.title: Editing a draft's fields saves the changes
test_cases.preconditions: Draft "Annual Partner Appreciation Dinner" from TC01, owned by rachel.ng@meridianfina.com, has no other fields set yet.
steps: Change Event name to "Annual Partner Appreciation Dinner - Updated"
Set Starts at to 10 Nov 2026, 9:00 AM and Ends at to 10 Nov 2026, 5:00 PM
test_cases.test_data: Event name: Annual Partner Appreciation Dinner - Updated; Type of event: Conference; Starts at: 10 Nov 2026, 9:00 AM; Ends at: 10 Nov 2026, 5:00 PM
test_cases.expected_result: The browser returns to "My events". Status remains "Draft". Reopening the draft shows all the updated values.

test_cases.title: Changing only the end time is checked against the already-saved start time
test_cases.preconditions: The draft from TC09 already has Starts at saved as 10 Nov 2026, 9:00 AM.
steps: Open the draft's "Edit draft" page (Starts at already shows 10 Nov 2026, 9:00 AM)
Change Ends at to 10 Nov 2026, 6:00 PM, without touching Starts at
test_cases.test_data: Ends at: 10 Nov 2026, 6:00 PM (Starts at left as already loaded, 9:00 AM)
test_cases.expected_result:
The change is saved without error, because 6:00 PM is after the already-saved 9:00 AM start.
Reopening the draft shows Ends at as 10 Nov 2026, 6:00 PM and Starts at unchanged at 9:00 AM.

test_cases.title: Changing the end time to before the already-saved start time is rejected
test_cases.preconditions: The draft from TC09/TC10 has Starts at saved as 10 Nov 2026, 9:00 AM.
steps: Change Ends at to 10 Nov 2026, 8:00 AM, without touching Starts at
test_cases.test_data: Ends at: 10 Nov 2026, 8:00 AM (before the loaded Starts at of 9:00 AM)
test_cases.expected_result: The page does not move on. A message "Ends at must be after starts at." appears under Ends at, and the previously saved Ends at value is not overwritten.

test_cases.title: A draft that gets submitted in another tab can no longer be saved from a stale edit tab
test_cases.preconditions: A draft owned by rachel.ng@meridianfina.com is complete enough to submit (Event name, Type, Starts at, Ends at and Expected attendance all filled in) and is currently open on its "Edit draft" page in Tab A.
steps: In a second browser tab (Tab B), log in as the same organiser and open the same draft
In Tab B, click "Submit request" so the event's status becomes "Submitted"
Switch back to Tab A, change the Description field, and click "Save draft"
test_cases.test_data: Description entered in Tab A: "trying to sneak an edit in"
test_cases.expected_result:
Tab A shows an error such as "Could not save this draft — Only draft requests can be edited."
The event's Description is not changed, and its status remains "Submitted".

test_cases.title: An equipment item already chosen in one row is not offered again in another row
test_cases.preconditions: The draft from TC09 already has Starts at and Ends at saved. The equipment catalogue has at least two active items.
steps: Click "Add equipment" and choose "4K Portable Projector" in the first row
Click "Add equipment" again to add a second row
Open the second row's equipment dropdown
test_cases.expected_result: "4K Portable Projector" is not listed as an option in the second row's dropdown — only items not already chosen elsewhere are offered. Choosing a different item in the second row and clicking "Save draft" saves both rows successfully.

test_cases.title: "Add equipment" is disabled once every catalogue item is already in the request
test_cases.preconditions: The draft from TC09 already has Starts at and Ends at saved. Note the total number of active items shown across the equipment dropdown (N).
steps: Click "Add equipment" and pick a different, not-yet-chosen item in each row, N times in total, until every catalogue item has been used
test_cases.test_data: One row per catalogue item, no repeats
test_cases.expected_result: Once the last item is chosen, the "Add equipment" button becomes disabled and the text "Every catalogue item is already in your request." appears beneath it.

test_cases.title: A complete draft can be submitted and leaves draft status
test_cases.preconditions: The draft from TC09 has Event name, Type, Starts at and Ends at set. Expected attendance is still missing.
test_cases.test_data: Expected attendance: 120 (everything else already saved from TC09)
test_cases.expected_result: The browser moves to the event's own page. Its status badge now reads "Submitted" instead of "Draft", and it no longer appears under "Drafts — not yet submitted" on "My events".

test_cases.title: An incomplete draft cannot be submitted from its edit page
test_cases.preconditions: The seeded draft "Q1 Investor Update (rough idea)", owned by rachel.ng@meridianfina.com, has only a title and description — Type of event, Starts at, Ends at and Expected attendance are all still empty.
steps: Without filling anything else in, click "Submit request"
test_cases.test_data: N/A — submitting the draft exactly as saved
test_cases.expected_result: The page does not move on. Messages appear at once under Type of event, Starts at, Ends at and Expected attendance, listing what's still needed; the draft is left exactly as it was, still showing the "Draft" badge.

test_cases.title: A draft never appears in the Submitted section of the owner's own events page
test_cases.preconditions: Seeded account rachel.ng@meridianfina.com owns the seeded draft "Q1 Investor Update (rough idea)" and the seeded, already-completed event "Meridian Compliance Training".
test_cases.expected_result: The draft appears only under "Drafts — not yet submitted". The "Submitted" section lists "Meridian Compliance Training" but not "Q1 Investor Update (rough idea)".

test_cases.title: A non-organiser role never sees another user's draft in the events list
test_cases.preconditions: daniel.tan@connectsphere.com is a seeded Coordinator who owns no events of his own. rachel.ng@meridianfina.com owns the seeded draft "Q1 Investor Update (rough idea)". budi.santoso@nusantaratec.com owns the seeded, already-submitted event "Nusantara Developer Summit".
test_cases.expected_result: "Nusantara Developer Summit" appears in the list. "Q1 Investor Update (rough idea)", or any other draft, does not appear anywhere on the page.

open_questions: SPM-24-TC13 originally tested that selecting the same equipment item twice was rejected after the fact, with an error message. The picker was changed so a duplicate can no longer be selected in the first place (the already-chosen item is removed from the other rows' dropdowns), which is why TC13 now tests prevention instead of rejection, and TC13b was added for the 'every item already used' edge case. The server-side Zod rule that used to produce the rejection message is still in place as a safety net (src/lib/validation/events.ts) but is no longer reachable by clicking through the app, so it isn't covered by a manual test case here — only by the existing unit test in src/lib/__tests__/validation.test.ts.
